name: game-playbook
description: Game business, design, and asset-sourcing playbooks: pre-launch market validation, post-launch metrics and unit economics, game design theory, and license-safe free asset acquisition.

interface.shortDescription: Validate, design, source, and measure games for profit.
interface.longDescription: Decision playbooks for game production: validate an idea's profit potential before building, apply design theory (MDA, flow, rewards, balance) while building, source free assets with a commercial-license gate, and judge post-launch metrics and unit economics with kill criteria.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate whether this game idea can make money overseas: give a GO / NO-GO / PIVOT verdict with kill criteria.
Review this game's design: is the core loop fun, and where does the difficulty curve break?
Find free commercial-safe assets for this game and generate the credits file.
Analyze my post-launch metrics and tell me whether to keep investing in this game.
